# Project Bubble

ProProfs Project is a project management tool that helps teams plan, collaborate, and deliver projects efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/project-bubble/.

## Actions

- **Data API Get Objects** (read-only): Retrieve a list of objects for a specified data type.
- **Get Record By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific record by id from the bubble data api.
- **Data API Get Data Type Fields** (read-only): Get the fields of a specific data type.
